title: Elemental damage
wikitext:
{{Redirect|Elemental Damage|the passive skill|Elemental Damage (passive skill)}}
{{Redirect|Elemental|the monster type|Water elemental}}

'''Elemental Damage''' refers to [[fire damage]], [[cold damage]], and [[lightning damage]] collectively. Passives or items which refer to elemental damage or elemental resistance will affect all 3 of these [[Damage Types]] or [[Resistance]]s.

==Base items==
The following base items are related to elemental damage:
{{Drop enabled base item table
|where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Element%"
   AND items.stat_text NOT LIKE "%Elemental%Resistances%"
   AND items.class_id NOT IN ("Active Skill Gem", "Support Skill Gem")
|large=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

==Unique items==
===Increased Elemental Damage===
Unique items that increase or reduce elemental damage by a percentage.
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
  item_stats.id LIKE "%elemental_damage_+\%%"
|stat_column1_header=% inc Elemental Damage
|stat_column1_format=%s%%
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=elemental_damage_+%
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

===Added as Elemental Damage===
Unique items that add a portion of other [[damage types]] as elemental damage.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
  item_stats.id LIKE "%add_as%element%"
|stat_column1_header=Phys %
|stat_column1_format=%s%%
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=weapon_physical_damage_%_to_add_as_each_element
|stat_column1_stat2_id=weapon_physical_damage_%_to_add_as_random_element
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

===Add a percentage of elemental damage as another damage type===
Unique items that add a percentage of the elemental damage as another damage type.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
  item_stats.id LIKE "%elemental_damage_\%_to_add%"
|stat_column1_header=Chaos %
|stat_column1_format=%s%%
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=elemental_damage_%_to_add_as_chaos
|stat_column1_stat2_id=local_unique_flask_elemental_damage_%_to_add_as_chaos_while_healing
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

==Passive skills==
There are [[passive skill]]s that grant elemental damage bonuses.

===Elemental damage===
These passive skills grant increased elemental damage.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "elemental_damage_+%"
}}

===Elemental damage with weapons===
These passive skills grant increased elemental damage with [[weapon]]s.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "elemental_damage_with_attack_skills_+%"
}}

===Elemental damage with maces===
These passive skills grant increased elemental damage with [[mace]]s.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "mace_elemental_damage_+%"
}}

===Elemental damage with wands===
These passive skills grant increased elemental damage with [[wand]]s.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "wand_elemental_damage_+%"
}}

===Miscellany===
These passive skills are related to elemental damage, but do not fit into any other category.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%elemental_damage%"
  AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("elemental_damage_+%", "elemental_damage_with_attack_skills_+%", "wand_elemental_damage_+%", "mace_elemental_damage_+%")
}}

===Cluster Jewel passive skills===
The following [[Cluster Jewel]] [[passive skill]]s are related to elemental damage:
{{Passive skill table
|q_where=passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%"
     AND passive_skills.is_keystone = 0
     AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Elemental_Damage%"
|large=1
|stat_text=1
}}

===Historic keystone passive skills===
The following [[Historic]] jewel [[keystone passive skill]]s are related to elemental damage:
{{Passive skill table
|q_where = ( passive_skills.id LIKE "%karui_keystone%" 
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%templar_keystone%" 
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%vaal_keystone%" 
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%maraketh_keystone%" 
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%eternal_keystone%" 
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%kalguur_keystone%"
OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%abyss%keystone%" ) AND 
passive_skills.name !="The Agnostic" AND
passive_skills.name !="Glancing Blows" AND
passive_skills.name !="Supreme Ego" AND
passive_skills.name !="Wind Dancer" AND
passive_skills.name !="Eternal Youth" AND 
passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%elemental%"
|stat_text=1
|large=1
}}

===Keystone passive skills===
The following [[keystone passive skill]]s are related to elemental damage:
{{Query keystone passive skills
|where=
  passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Elemental_Damage%"
}}

===Masteries===
The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to elemental damage:
{{Query masteries}}

===Ascendancy passive skills===
{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%elemental_damage%"
}}
